reason: The text contains explicit instructions for collaborative leadership. God commands Moses to gather the elders of Israel (לֵך וְאָֽסַפְתָּ אֶת־ זִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל), and then directs that both Moses and the elders of Israel ('אַתָּה וְזִקְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל') will come together to the king of Egypt to make their petition. Additionally, the text states that the people will listen to Moses's voice ('וְשָׁמְע֖וּ לְקֹלֶ֑ךָ'), establishing a structured chain of communication and unified action between leader and people. The passage outlines a coordinated effort where leadership structures and the broader community work together in pursuing their shared goal of deliverance.
